description: Shaman spells, disciplines, and cooldowns. Updated October 2, 2026.

triggers.worn_off_pattern: (?:^You return to your body\.$)|(?:^LOADING, PLEASE WAIT\.\.\.$)

triggers.name: Slam Cooldown
triggers.pattern: ^(You bash {S} for {N} poin(t|ts) of damage\.|You try to bash .+, but (miss|(.+ (ripostes|dodges|parries)|.+'s magical skin absorbs the blow))\!)$
